text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 风险应对七连招(威胁五招+机会四招,上报通用)

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 乌云怪来了,怎么办?

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 规避

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 绕着走,改计划让它发生不了

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 转移

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 买保险/外包,把后果递给别人

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 减轻

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 举盾,降概率降影响

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 接受

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 躺平:主动留应急储备,被动硬扛

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: ※ 上报:超出项目权限,交给上级组织

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 金元宝掉下来,接不接?

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 开拓

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 主动创造条件,确保它发生

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 分享

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 找伙伴合伙,一起把蛋糕做大

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 提高

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 浇灌施肥,放大概率和收益

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: ※ 机会也可以『接受』:不主动追,来了不拒

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif

svg.text: 口诀:威胁-避转减受,机会-开分提受,搞不定就上报
